text:
zara: Heads-up: drafting the release notes for the docs push. Key items: migration guide v0.9 -> v1.0, standardize streaming SDK snippets, Known Issues blurb for embed streaming fallback. Need final checks by Thursday EOD.

jay: I'll review the SDK snippets. Saw a mismatched python example in PR #4721.

zara: PR #4721 is the one; I marked an old `client.call()` usage in python.

miguel: I'll update curl examples to /v1/streams and add a jq snippet for chunked token parsing. Example I'll add:
```bash
curl -s -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"kestrel-1","input":"hi"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/streams | jq -c 'select(.type=="token") | .data.text'
```
This should help folks migrate from single-response flows.

elaine: Ran anchor-check locally. Issues: docs/guides/migration.md missing #private-deploy anchor (2 refs); docs/snippets/streaming.md example id mismatch. Command: `./scripts/anchor-check --fail-on=missing`
docs-bot: CI: docs-linkcheck triggered on PR #4721. Status: failed (2 broken anchors).
sam: I'll add frontmatter redirects in migration.md to preserve the old anchors -> new `private-deploy` ids. Tiny patch.
jay: Proposal: canonicalize snippets to `client.generate_stream()` across languages, include a short compatibility note: "Older SDKs expose streaming under `client.stream.*`." Pushed draft to PR #4729.

zara: Add a Known Issues blurb: "On rare capacity constraints embed streaming may fall back to polling; tokens can be delayed up to ~2s. The service will attempt to resume streaming automatically." Make it brief and customer-facing.

miguel: Also updating the migration guide's batching paragraph to note default server-side batching reduces per-token cost in production; will add a short cost note.

elaine: After sam's redirect patch lands I'll re-run anchor-check and re-trigger CI.
sam: Redirects pushed in a tiny PR.
docs-bot: Summary: #4721 (streaming-update): failing links; #4729 (snippets-unify): snippet-tests pending; redirect PR: lint OK.
jay: I'll run snippet-tests locally against py runner v0.9.2 and update tests if needed. If runtime changes required, we'll add a callout in relnotes.
zara: Timeline: edits done by Thursday EOD, final review Friday morning, publish Friday noon PT. Ping here when PRs are green. :rocket:
